thesis: CRAI is a real relative-strength leader: it is at a 52-week high after a Q3 beat where YoY revenue (+15.6%) and net income (+21.2%) both sped up, and the Barrington target raise to 260 is near the 258 mean. But it last traded at 217.19 (pre-market 217.95), above the 210.9-215.0 pullback zone, with RSI 75 and +9% in 5 days. From the last price the R/R to 245.9 vs the 195.1 stop is only about 1.3 (1.84 holds only from the 213 midpoint), and the regime is risk-off at 0.93 confidence with VIX at its 99.5th percentile. Per provisional lesson 1 (downgrade to Hold when R/R at the last price is below 1.5), this is a Hold that becomes actionable only if price pulls back into 210.9-215.0 and holds above about 201 (SMA20). Notes: news is titles only (google_rss); the stop and target are unchanged from the technical card; horizon is extended to 15 days because the 32.9-point measured move is about 4.6 ATR.
invalidation: A daily close below 195.1, or a close back under the SMA20 (about 201) after the 218.5 breakout fails to hold.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (confidence 0.93, QQQ ret_21 -11.05%, VIX 31.37), so a small cap could gap with index selling
Technically extended (RSI 75, 8% above SMA20); the pullback fill may come with breakdown momentum rather than as a buyable dip
Net debt (totalDebt 227.5M vs cash 20.4M, D/E 118) and thin coverage (2 analysts), so liquidity and gap risk are high
Sequential revenue growth is slowing (200.98M, 210.8M, 214.9M); growth is accelerating on a YoY basis only
CEO 10b5-1 sale of 7,500 shares near the highs; ex-dividend of 0.67 around 2026-11-23
